Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for bringing these three requirements forward before I sign off. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and lay out the plan.

First, from Maj. Alvarez: the water plant's morning startup pump draws 55 kW from 0600 to 0800, so it must be on G-1 during that window since G-2 is only rated for 40 kW.

Second, from Lt. Brooks: the clinic's medication freezer requires continuous G-2 power from 0000 through 2400 tomorrow. That commits G-2 to the clinic for the entire day.

Third, from Capt. Shah: the communications annex needs G-1 support at exactly 1500 tomorrow for a transfer test following UPS maintenance from 1300 to 1500.

Here's the plan as I see it: G-2 is committed to the clinic for all 24 hours. G-1 will support the water plant from 0600 to 0800 for the startup pump, and G-1 will support the communications annex at 1500 for the transfer test. There is no conflict between these two G-1 commitments since they fall in non-overlapping windows.

Before I sign off, I need all three of these requirements formally entered into the facility support log and power schedule. Maj. Alvarez, please ensure the water plant 55 kW draw is logged. Lt. Brooks, get the clinic's 24-hour G-2 commitment into the support log. Capt. Shah, enter the comms annex G-1 transfer test at 1500 into the power schedule. Once those entries are confirmed, I'll publish the final power plan and fuel-control instructions.
